narrative.intro: National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia obligated $4.7B in FY2026 to date. National Technology and Engineering Solutions of Sandia recorded 1 award in the current period, with an average award size of $4.7B. Obligations fell 16.5% year over year. Annual obligations show a multi-year sequence: FY21 $4.3B, FY22 $4.3B, FY23 $4.7B, FY24 $5B, FY25 $5.7B, FY26 $4.7B. The single award in the current period accounts for the entire $4.7B total and matches the reported average award size. The FY26 total is lower than FY25, which stood at $5.7B. The FY24 figure was $5B and the FY23 figure was $4.7B, matching the current-year total. This profile indicates a high concentration of obligations in a single award in FY2026 to date and a year-over-year decline of 16.5% versus the prior period. Readers should treat the FY2026 total as a fiscal year to date number, not a full-year total.
